purpose.summary: Release the complete owned Chronik startup graph immediately after a successful synchronous finish fence and before bridge publication.
scope: Direct child of signed public main d68d625 integrated by PR61; five technical postimages plus finite policy, documentation and CI only.
Revalidate native source and storage under cs_main and the mempool lock, then destroy the owned graph outside both native locks.
Expose native-test-only retained index count and a conservative byte floor, and bind strict and service success paths to zero retention and the live native tip.
Expand only the owned-startup group to four cases and 607 assertions under the unchanged 60-second deadline.
exclusions: No upstream Rust indexer, ALP parser, plugin engine, dependency, consensus, activation, network identity, default, service limit, RPC or wallet change.
No RSS or full-chain memory claim, server deployment, cutover, release or desktop integration.
No incoming report, raw output, binary, private history, host metadata, operator material or proof promotion.

limitations: The startup graph remains bounded to the existing 2000-height/4096-index local-regtest profile.
The portable retained-byte floor excludes map-node and allocator overhead and is not an RSS measurement.
Cancellation and failed fences retain the graph for retry or destruction; only successful synchronous finish releases it early.
System build dependencies remain unlocked and no reproducible-build claim is made.
counterevidence: Historical runtime timeouts and dependency warnings remain open and are not erased by this change.
No server, operator datadir, mainnet history or production replacement is exercised.
